---
applyTo: "backend/apps/**/db/migration/*.sql"
---

# Flyway migration rules (learning mode applies — one statement block at a time)

Source of truth: `docs/spec/02-data-model.md`.

- File names: `V<NNN>__<snake_case_description>.sql` (two underscores). Never edit a migration that has been applied; add a new one.
- One concern per migration (one table plus its indexes, or one change).
- Primary keys: `id uuid PRIMARY KEY` (UUIDv7 generated by the app). No `serial` except append-only logs that use `bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY`.
- Every tenant table has `workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspace(id)`.
- Timestamps: `timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`.
- Enumerations: `text` + `CHECK (col IN (...))`, not Postgres `ENUM` (easier to evolve).
- Rank columns: `text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL` so ordering is byte-wise.
- Name constraints and indexes explicitly: `pk_`, `fk_<table>_<col>`, `uq_<table>_<cols>`, `ix_<table>_<cols>`, `ck_<table>_<col>`.
- Explain every index: which query in the spec it serves.
